This experience is a testament to ArchViz and 3D Visualization capability that Mixeal offers to its clients. Immerse yourself in high-quality visuals with fun hand-tracking interactions that makes you feel right at home.

Whether you're walking through the cozy interiors or interacting with objects, the experience is seamless and engaging.
